F14_ratio_cost_rate.call_parameter_summary: analysis-run SQL computed cost_amount/revenue_amount/cost_rate_pct; then finance_context_save, run_metric kind=ratio, run_metric kind=management_pnl, drilldown cost/revenue, draft claims cost_amount/revenue_amount/cost_rate_pct.
F14_ratio_cost_rate.reproducible_cause: The deterministic operator did not return an exact Decimal ratio field matching fixture truth; available successful run rounded percent to 58.3333 and draft verified that rounded percent. Numerator and denominator were correct. This is a precision/output-shape mismatch, not wrong range selection.

F19_prior_period_comparison.call_parameter_summary: finance_context_save bound one mom dataset without scenario-specific actual/baseline bindings; explain_variance kind=profit_bridge actual_scenario=current baseline_scenario=prior; custom analysis-run then calculated month-over-month deltas and draft claims against that run.
F19_prior_period_comparison.reproducible_cause: The built-in explain_variance operator could not pair current/prior periods because the context binding did not expose actual and baseline groups; it emitted incomplete rows with comparison_group_missing diagnostics. The model then used custom SQL and got revenue/profit numerically right, but represented cost_change as +4 and narrative as an unfavorable cost increase, while fixture expected profit-impact contribution -4. This is model/context-binding and sign-convention mismatch, not deterministic arithmetic corruption.
